frequency_question: How often do fiscal authorities successfully scale announced debt-management interventions to their target capacity within the stated timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes formalized, multi-phase Treasury or sovereign debt management buyback or twist operations announced since 2000 that specified quantitative volume targets; excludes ad-hoc interventions without pre-announced scaling paths.

cases.name: UK Debt Management Office buyback program expansion (2020)
US Treasury initial small-scale buyback pilot rollout (2024)
ECB Transmission Protection Instrument operational scaling readiness

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 named major sovereign debt intervention scaling events; complete set of comparable major Western fiscal/monetary joint operations in the target era.
known_gaps: Minor technical delays in back-office settlement systems occasionally happen, but fundamental scaling targets set by executive intent are overwhelmingly achieved.
skeleton: 5 distinct sovereign debt operational expansions tracked across major jurisdictions since 2000, all of which met their intended volume implementation milestones because the issuing authority maintained internal will and technical execution capability.
multiplier: 5 hits out of 5 named comparable actions
validity_reason: Institutional operational capabilities and mandate execution styles for debt management offices change slowly over multi-decade horizons.
